kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ارتأست (form VIII)
# اِرْتَأَسْتُ (irtaʔastu) /ir.ta.ʔas.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# اِرْتَأَسْتَ (irtaʔasta) /ir.ta.ʔas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# اِرْتَأَسْتِ (irtaʔasti) /ir.ta.ʔas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# اِرْتَأَسَتْ (irtaʔasat) /ir.ta.ʔa.sat/: third-perso
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
